_comment: Mobilizon instances (https://joinmobilizon.org) - federated AGPL event software. Public GraphQL at {base}/api, no key. Its EventCategory enum has 30 values that map almost one-to-one onto mapsee's, so these arrive correctly filed rather than keyword-guessed; `category` here is only the fallback for the handful with no honest home. NOTE for anyone extending this list: geom is 'lon;lat', longitude FIRST - read it backwards and every European event lands in the Gulf of Guinea. A keyless directory of live instances is at https://instances.joinmobilizon.org/api/v1/instances?count=200 if you want to widen this.

_not_included.https://keskonfai.fr: 205k events, but machine-ingested from tourist-office feeds rather than grassroots - a different kind of source with its own licence to check before use.
_not_included.https://mobilizon.us: heavily spammed; scam listings geocoded to France.
